HTTP_REJECT
Description
Triggers when HTTP encounters an error condition, and aborts the
connection. This event is designed for debugging issues with the HTTP
filter. Note that when this event is triggered most HTTP commands will
not work as all HTTP connection state will have been aborted. You may
want to store useful information in earlier iRule events in TCL
variables to be printed in log messages here.
Examples
when
HTTP_REJECT
{
log
local0.
"HTTP Aborted:"
[
HTTP
::
reject_reason
]
}
